title: I feel ~
situation: Talking about feelings and body conditions at work and in daily life.
objective: Use I feel + adjective to describe feelings and physical conditions.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel tired after the night shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa lelah setelah shift malam.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa lapar sebelum makan siang.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel happy when the machine works well.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa senang ketika mesin berfungsi dengan baik.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel nervous when I call the remote engineer.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa gugup ketika menelepon engineer jarak jauh.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel confident about this repair.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa yakin dengan perbaikan ini.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel better after a short break.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa lebih baik setelah istirahat singkat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel sleepy in the early morning.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa mengantuk di pagi buta.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel worried about the conveyor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel proud of my team.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa bangga dengan tim saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I feel relaxed after the shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya merasa santai setelah shift selesai.

learningNotes: Rumus: I feel + kata sifat (adjective). Pola ini dipakai untuk menyebut perasaan atau kondisi tubuh.
Boleh ditambah keterangan waktu atau alasan, misalnya: I feel tired after the shift.
